item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=multi-agent+reinforcement+learning+path+dependence+preference+stability+initial+conditions&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Space–Air–Ground Integrated Networks for Smart Agriculture and Smart Breeding: A Review of SDN/NFV-Enabled Intelligent Resource Management\", \"abstract\": null, \"doi\": null, \"pmid\": \"PMC13667718\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13667718\", \"source\": \"PMC\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13667718/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13667718/pdf/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13667718\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13667718?pdf=render\"}]}}, {\"title\": \"PPO-GAT-Follow: Graph-Attention Reinforcement Learning for Robust Robot Person Following in Dense Crowds.\", \"abstract\": \"Robot person following (RPF) in dense crowds requires a mobile robot to maintain an appropriate relative position with respect to a moving target while avoiding surrounding pedestrians and satisfying rear-following and social constraints. This paper proposes PPO-GAT-Follow, an interaction-aware reinforcement learning framework for dense-crowd RPF under geometric visibility loss with available target-relative pose estimates. The follower, target pedestrian, and surrounding pedestrians are represented as graph nodes, and a graph attention encoder models their local interactions. A task-oriented reward mechanism jointly accounts for target maintenance, visibility preservation, collision avoidance, proximity-aware social compliance, rear position maintenance, post-arrival stabilization, and action stability.
